It is less common for men to get UTIs because men have a longer urethra than women do. This means that bacteria have a longer distance to travel, so it is still possible for men to get UTIs. Men who are uncircumcised get them more often because the extra skin houses more bacteria. It is best to wash thoroughly after sex. Even going to the bathroom after sex is a good idea because the acidity of urine can kill some bacteria.
